name: Booster mission
summary: Launch and land a Falcon 9-class booster live: the precomputed launch, flip and entry burn, then the learned policy lands it on the drone ship.
help: Wire a booster_policy.pt (the Policy of Booster landing: train, for example from its dataset) to Policy and the block's telemetry, through a Telemetry block, to one or more 3D views. Press Launch (control channel, from the 3D view's or a Controls view's buttons): a 10-second countdown, lift-off on nine engines, max-Q, main engine cut-off and separation (the second stage lights its vacuum engine), the flip on nitrogen thrusters, grid fins out, a coast over about 160 km, the three-engine entry burn, then the learned policy flies the grid-fin glide and the single-engine landing burn to the drone ship about 700 km downrange, which waits where the booster would fall without steering (Ship offset moves it). Real time by default, Time warp up to 20x. Wind (m/s at the sea, growing with height), Jet stream (m/s near 11 km) and Sea (0 calm to 1 rough: the deck heaves, pitches and rolls) take effect at the next Launch. Channel rocket carries the flight (esasim.rocket/1: 20 frames a second, plus alt_km, speed_kmh, throttle, prop_t, downrange_km, q_kpa, to_ship_km, phase, clock for gauges); channel event the milestones; flights.csv the results. The run waits for the next Launch until it is stopped.
